title.suggested: Third Deposit Made at Allen's Saloon for McCoole Fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat reported that the third $500-a-side deposit for the Allen-McCoole fight, set for September 23, was made before a large crowd at Tom Allen's saloon on Washington Avenue between Fourth and Fifth.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Wednesday, July 9, 1873'; masthead 'Daily Democrat'. Pre-1875 merger, so not the Globe-Democrat.

facts.fact: The third $500-a-side deposit for the Allen-McCoole fight was made at Allen's saloon; the fight was set for September 23, 1873
